scope: Static source only. No product/test/doc changes; no browser/network/image/video execution. Inventory is not implementation, proof, or visual success.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw; drawAffPlain→env.draw
rows.primaryAndOwned: All lyric chunks, altCopy, side numeral and top No.; complete faces, edges and contact shadow owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Face schedule, yaw/pitch/pop extrema; preserve face-local writing fields and pair/turn chronology; adjust cube centers/spacing then face writing measure.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw; env.draw charFn rings; direct clipped band
rows.primaryAndOwned: Front lyric AND deliberate secondary circular source rings; band/glass geometry owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound ring charFn mirrored back half, cos visibility thresholds, spin/tilt/shear and row pitch; change drum radius/row spacing without turning into center-only layout.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw; drawAffPlain→env.draw ranks; env.draw decoy peek
rows.primaryAndOwned: Card faces, corner lyric ranks and center glyphs; bodies/shadows owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Face-down table and literal ?/star peek are independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound face-up switch, flip squashes/perspective-height proxy and stagger; reorganize card rows/pitch together.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw
rows.primaryAndOwned: Printed glyphs, fold panels, covers and strip shadow owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound fold cosine, alternating panel heights and vertical axis swap; adjust panel pitch/fold depth, retaining ordered rows.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw; direct cloth shading clip
rows.primaryAndOwned: Glyphs with cloth silhouette/trims, pole/rope attachment owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound finite-difference slope, discrete 30-strip accumulation, sampled interpolation and swallowtail domain; change cloth measure/wave/path while retaining pole attachment.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw per path glyph
rows.primaryAndOwned: Lyric, twisted ribbon band/back/tails/shadow owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound 90-sample arc-length inverse and 64-segment band, twist and reveal; adjust path measure/bend/rows, keep glyph-band ownership.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw cradle or fan/chunks
rows.primaryAndOwned: Glyph bobs/plates, strings and pivot/frame owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Impact sparks independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Mode-specific angular/length/drop envelopes, string attachments and frame; adjust anchors/pitch/string length rather than detached glyph motion.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw falling glyph; env.draw charFn heap
rows.primaryAndOwned: Falling/settled source glyphs primary; mound supporting scene requires explicit ownership
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Seeded heap up to 200 filler glyphs is dense tiledAux candidate; dust independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound fall/bounce/settled slope, layer schedule and mound profile; adapt settled row pitch/peak, preserve heap route for 018 after named review.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw with separate context body transform
rows.primaryAndOwned: Lyric blocks, projected top/side faces and supporting blank overhang blocks owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Outer shape-only toy blocks and floor are independent scene decor unless explicitly coupled
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound pivoted rotation/squash/fall/hop and oblique faces; change block row/pitch with supports, not just face glyph.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw body; env.draw rim and clipped gloss
rows.primaryAndOwned: Every source glyph body, fat rim, clipped gloss, knot and attached strings owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound overshooting outBack size, bob/rotation/fly and tied endpoints; reorganize balloon rows/string length preserving bunch relation.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw lyric; env.draw lyric shadow and decoys
rows.primaryAndOwned: Lyric magnets and stroke/shadow copies owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: DECOY literal edge magnets, fridge board/handle independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound snap overshoot/lift shadow offsets/rotation; rearrange lyric magnet rows while keeping board writing field constraints.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw; env.draw point values and SCORE
rows.primaryAndOwned: Tile faces/edges, point values, lyric, rack and total score metadata owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound tile drop/slide/exit/rotation and rack lip occlusion; adapt tile/rack pitch/rows and score placement jointly.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw; env.draw subtitle
rows.primaryAndOwned: Sign board, shadow, bulb rim, complete lyric and altCopy subtitle owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound board outBack scale, arrow tip and bulb halo; alter board writing field and rim pitch preserving subtitle margin.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw scroll copies; env.draw info; clip; offscreen dot-pattern tiles
rows.primaryAndOwned: Complete scrolling source copies, module housing, LED masks/dots and info strip incl altCopy/time owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: No auxiliary exemption: repeated main text is source scroll
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound snapped modulo scroll at wrap boundaries and panel clip in same space; adapt display width/lanes/info strip while preserving complete source-scroll schedule.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw; env.draw No./time; direct clipped lighting
rows.primaryAndOwned: Board, source lyric, tag/time and attached supporting posts/lamps owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Ground/horizon scene decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound rise, board writing field, posts and clipped lamp cones; adjust board aspect/post geometry together.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw hero; env.draw crowd captions
rows.primaryAndOwned: Hero bubble/tail/lyric primary; crowd lyric fragments and their bubbles default primary pending named review
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Literal REACT captions may be independent decor only when unit provenance identifies them
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound life-generation slots, pop overshoot/tails and fragment text widths; adapt hero/crowd spacing; no blanket crowd exemption.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw lyric cells; env.draw numbers/pencil/clues
rows.primaryAndOwned: Lyric grid cells, paper, numbers, crossing entries and note/romaji clues owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None; pencil crossings are deliberately selected entries, not dense tiled background
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound typing clocks/grid growth and clue extent; adapt cell measure/clue arrangement preserving crossings and source order.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw path; direct fillText filler or env.draw charFn fallback
rows.primaryAndOwned: Path lyric, find capsule and grid writing panel owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Off-path seeded kana filler is dense tiledAux candidate; earlier decoy capsules independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound path/grid dimensions, capsule sweep and both filler branches; change cell pitch/path direction jointly, preserve onPath blanking.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw repeated under jigsaw clip; direct piece shadow/seams
rows.primaryAndOwned: Every clipped lyric portion and piece plate/seam/shadow owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Landing flash decor follows piece but is not text
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bezier knob extrema, settled compound clip union plus each moving transform/clip and arrival path; change piece grid/paths with complete source coverage.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw solid; drawAff→mainDraw cast copies
rows.primaryAndOwned: Solid and cast lyric primary; floor/lamp relation must remain explicit scene ownership
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Sun/lamp/floor background fields may stay independent if adapter preserves relation
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound cast shear/scale/floor clip and finite blur support at alpha threshold; retain light direction, floor baseline and solid/cast relationship.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw hero; env.draw in mirrored sector clips
rows.primaryAndOwned: Complete hero lyric and central disc/band owned primary
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: 6–12 sectors × five radial background captions dense tiledAux candidate; sector lines independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound hero pop/disc or full-width band writing domain; adapt hero field/disc radius; defer named radial repetitions to 018; no center-only promotion.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw; context-transformed face/pips
rows.primaryAndOwned: Printed glyph, face/side/shadow/pips owned per domino
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Floor line independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound per-piece fall/stand outBack angle, pivot and side thickness; adapt row pitch while retaining chain direction and phase.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw; procedural star polygons
rows.primaryAndOwned: Complete lyric with all star plates and plate shadow owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Shock ring, speed lines and debris independent decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound pop/boil-step vertices/rotation; vary ray proportions/writing field preserving plate text fit.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw each scaled/reflowed glyph
rows.primaryAndOwned: Every lens-scaled lyric glyph primary; lens marker ownership explicit
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Grid/lens handle independent decor unless intentionally attached to relocated lens
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound Gaussian scale, sum-of-width reflow, best-glyph discontinuities and sweep/pingpong; adapt lens path/strength and row pitch together.

rows.constructionPath: drawAff→mainDraw front; drawAffPlain→env.draw other wall
rows.primaryAndOwned: Front lyric/wall primary; other-wall 3/4 rows of repeated line default primary pending named review
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Other-wall repetition is an auxiliary candidate requiring unit-level review, never whole wall exemption
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Perspective denominator positive over all source domains; numeric Jacobian per-glyph is actual draw matrix, not exact projective text; bound yaw and moving wall length, both face writing fields.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw gate/blintz; over/under face painter split
rows.primaryAndOwned: Lyric, sheet, shadow, creases and folding flaps owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound flap cosine sign/topology, shrink and diamond writing field; adapt sheet aspect/text measure retaining front/back painter order.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw below opaque cloth; env.poly covers (no Canvas text clip)
rows.primaryAndOwned: Complete lyric, cloth halves, teeth/tape/stitch/slider/tab owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound moving gap and opaque cover domains/vertical swap; preserve reveal composition while adapting zipper path/tooth pitch/text field; do not misreport as literal ctx.clip.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw under clips/context transforms; extrusion copies
rows.primaryAndOwned: All source slices, extrusion copies and blind slats/rail/cord owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Track stage-space clip established before translations/scales, slice union and culling; bound dx/dy/depth and blind cosine; adapt pitch/depth with complete source coverage.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw clean hero; env.draw clipped full copies and CH./REC labels
rows.primaryAndOwned: Clean source AND visible full-source cell fragments default primary; cell plates and labels owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: No named reviewed tiledAux exemption established
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound seeded finite rate/step states, zoom/offset/slit and per-cell clip; adapt cell field/clean lane; preserve source fragment provenance and painter order.

rows.constructionPath: mosaicSample offscreen fillText/strokeText/getImageData; mainDraw through animated tile clip
rows.primaryAndOwned: Offscreen source raster is primary provenance; lit tile union, fat primary ink and bevels owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Grout floor independent scene decor
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Sampler/font revision/D threshold domain separate from stage tile pitch; bound tile overshoot/rotation and clip intersection; adapt tile pitch/writing field with nonempty sample coverage.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw withFill/rim; env.draw label; offscreen fillText texture
rows.primaryAndOwned: Primary glyph, repeated line texture INSIDE fill, rim and altCopy label owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None; repeated texture is not stage tiledAux
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Bound glyph/rim/label; preserve glyph-local DOMMatrix pattern and fillOf/charFns interaction; adapt writing measure without moving texture as separate scene text.

rows.constructionPath: direct strokeText/fillText rings; mainDraw full lyric; env.draw metadata
rows.primaryAndOwned: Selected first kanji/eligible source glyph, all contour rings/fill, full lyric and metadata primary
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Actual Canvas text metrics at bs plus maximum half stroke, modulo phase/grow and painter fill; adapt contour radius/spacing and side lyric field, preserve large glyph identity.

rows.constructionPath: coverage offscreen fillText/getImageData; mainDraw duo/fallback/screen clip
rows.primaryAndOwned: Offscreen alpha source provenance, screened lyric and optional offset duo copy primary
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: None; screen dots/lines construct lyric
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Sampler coverage threshold separate from rotated stage screen; bound dot/line growth, enlarged stroke and duo offset, crop mode and 4000 cap; adapt screen pitch/writing measure preserving construction.

rows.constructionPath: mainDraw under nozzle then evenodd clips; env.draw metadata; direct mist/drips
rows.primaryAndOwned: Bridged primary glyph, spray/drips, marks/metadata owned
rows.auxiliaryAndIndependent: Nozzle cloud may be independent transient decor if reviewed
rows.requiredStrategyAndBounds: Track pre-tilt nozzle clip, evenodd bridge holes, inverse transform composition and later spray/drip support; adapt stencil field/spray path while retaining bridges and source ink.
